svg.title: Phase 1 wiring: Uno R4 WiFi, 100 ohm resistor and passive piezo buzzer on a breadboard
svg.desc: R4 D8 to breadboard a10; 100 ohm resistor c10 to c14; buzzer + in e14, - in e17; a17 to the top - rail; R4 GND (top header) to the top - rail; power bank to R4 USB-C.
svg.text: Phase 1 wiring: R4 + 100 ohm resistor + passive piezo buzzer
Pin-to-pin. Every wire below is one jumper. Matches firmware/phase1-r4-finder (BUZZER_PIN = 8).
Arduino Uno R4 WiFi (top view, 5 V logic)
(+ leg is the longer one / marked +)
Wire list (breadboard columns 10, 14, 17 are examples; any free columns work)
How it connects: holes a-e of one column are joined underneath, so W1 (a10) meets R1 (c10),
R1 (c14) meets the buzzer + (e14), and the buzzer - (e17) meets W3 (a17). W2 and W3 share the - rail.
W1 and W2 need a MALE end at the R4 (its headers are sockets) and a male end in the breadboard.
